                                                                                
 Usage: agentarts runtime [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                           
                                                                                
 Runtime operations (cloud only): invoke, exec-command, upload-files,           
 download-files, start-session, stop-session                                    
                                                                                
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ invoke          Invoke agent with JSON payload.                              │
│ exec-command    Execute command in runtime (cloud only).                     │
│ upload-files    Upload files to runtime (cloud only).                        │
│ download-files  Download files from runtime (cloud only).                    │
│ start-session   Start runtime session (cloud only).                          │
│ stop-session    Stop runtime session (cloud only).                           │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
